output.scope_note: The paper is mainly a method for analysing MD jump diffusion, but it reports one ionic conductivity of a solid Li-ion conductor (LLZO), computed in this work via Nernst-Einstein.

records.measurement_method: classical MD simulation with Nernst-Einstein relation and Haven ratio
records.evidence_quote: We find σ = 0.58 Scm−1, which is one
records.notes: Conductivity is derived from the simulated tracer diffusion coefficient via the Nernst-Einstein equation with a Haven ratio H = 0.4 taken from literature (Ref. 63); the simulation was run at 500 K (canonical ensemble, polarizable force field). Value is computed in this paper, not a literature value. No sintering or synthesis since it is a simulation.
